View-only demo of the test copy that runs in the browser, with these test parts analyzed in advance by its own engine. Tap a part (a turning part opens on Turning): it opens on its overview; walk the five steps with the tabs, Next and Back. On milled parts it runs the hole, pocket and wall checks (hole depth and size, corner radius, pocket depth, undercut, thin wall and access) and works out the machine plan and cost drivers; the process check, the .ipt checks and turned parts come in later slices, and each step names what is not done yet. Your files can't be uploaded here. Export PDF saves nothing in this viewer, which blocks downloads; it works in the app.
